OnboardingData.description: Draft fields (all optional while saving; `complete` validates required ones).
OnboardingData.title: OnboardingData

ReportEvaluationSummary.description: Automated document-based report evaluation (ADR-017). Not a verified practical result.
ReportEvaluationSummary.title: ReportEvaluationSummary

ReportedMark.description: A mark explicitly stated in the resume (resume_reported, unverified; never a verified gate).
ReportedMark.title: ReportedMark

ReportedScoresIn.description:
Resume-reported marks the trainee confirmed or corrected. Stored as unverified claims: they never
replace imported/verified marks and never satisfy a verified-assessment gate (ADR-017 §6.2).
ReportedScoresIn.title: ReportedScoresIn

post.description:
Optional nudge: queue an allocation run now (the schedule runs it anyway). Without `cycle_id`: every
active cycle (ADR-018).

Staff spreadsheet (XLSX/CSV: Email, Full Name, Role [supervisor|admin], optional Department).
Each valid new address gets an invitation and a queued email. Existing users/invites are skipped.

Only the trainee who owns the active allocation, before any submission, while the cycle is open.
Replaying the same idempotency key returns the stored result without new jobs or counts.

get.description: The caller's default cycle: a student's own open cycle; for staff the newest active one (a UI default).

put.description: Save progress (partial data allowed). Gender stays private and is never a matching input.

get.description: Live ranking while the student edits trades (ADR-018). Read-only; reveals only cycle names and counts.

post.description: Regenerate metadata/guide (explicit admin values are still kept).

Take a project out of allocation (draft/archived) or put a READY project back. Existing
individual allocations are never removed by a transition.

get.description: Printable HTML of exactly the persisted findings and the current review state.

post.description: Retry a FAILED analysis (same revision; completed deterministic stages are reused).
Supervisor/admin review: keeps the automated findings and adds a review history entry.

Verified practical evaluation by the supervisor (observed workmanship, demo, safety, viva). Separate
from the automated report evaluation; recorded only with real evidence, once per version.

get.description: The student's own allocations in every cycle (current, rejected, archived). Read-only.
